title: Runtime-adaptive kernel selector with calibration feedback loop
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Build a runtime-side kernel selector that uses live calibration signals and offline quant profiles to choose between FP16/FP8/INT8 execution paths. This ticket implements an adaptive decision layer that: 1) ingests per-model quantization profiles (per-layer scale/zero-point/fp8-e4m3/meta) produced by the calibration pipeline, 2) monitors runtime accuracy proxies (softmax entropy drift, token-level perplexity delta on golden prompts, and sampled output similarity against a high-precision baseline), and 3) routes inference to the optimal kernel variant (native FP16 kernel, fp8-optimized kernel, or int8 fast-path) with confidence thresholds and fallback rules. The selector should expose telemetry for per-route decisions, rationale for fallback, and integrate with rollouts in the Console for canary testing. This reduces customer regressions when applying aggressive quantization profiles and enables safe, automated cost/latency trade-offs.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime exposes a kernel selection API that returns chosen precision path (FP16|FP8|INT8) and decision reason for every request
Selector uses calibration profile metadata (per-layer signal-to-noise, per-op quant-compatibility flags) and runtime accuracy proxies to make decisions
Fallback to high-precision FP16 occurs when proxy drift exceeds configured threshold or model-specific safety flags are set
End-to-end tests demonstrate <1% relative degradation on holdout eval set for FP8/INT8 routes compared to FP16 baseline for supported models
Telemetry integrated into Console: per-route histograms of chosen path, latency, and estimated token-cost delta
Rollout integration: canary traffic can be pinned to mixed-precision selector and automatic rollback triggers on accuracy regression metric
Documentation (Confluence) describing config knobs, calibration artifact schema, and recommended per-workload thresholds
tasks: Define calibration artifact schema and metadata fields needed by runtime (per-layer bitwidth suggestion, expected quant error, calibration-date)
Implement kernel selector module with pluggable decision rules: static-profile, confidence-threshold, and budget-aware modes
Add runtime probes for accuracy proxies: softmax entropy, ngram overlap on sample prompts, and sampled similarity to FP16 baseline
Wire selector to serving runtime dispatch hook and ensure zero-copy path when switching kernels
Create automated validation harness that replays a representative prompt set across FP16/FP8/INT8 to compute eval deltas
Expose telemetry tags and metrics to Console and Perf Dashboard (chosen_path, decision_reason, proxy_score, fallback_flag)
Author Confluence runbook and add a Console rollout recipe for mixed-precision canaries
Write unit and integration tests; performance microbenchmarks for each hardware target
progress_updates: 2025-02-14: Proposal drafted and reviewed with Runtime and Applied ML. Decision to prioritize fp8 support for Llama-family models due to strong calibration results.

2025-02-21: Calibration artifact schema v1 created (link below). Added fields for per-layer quant-error and stable-token-ratio. Open questions: how to represent activation outliers across sequence positions.

2025-02-28: Initial kernel selector PoC committed in branch feature/quant-adaptive-select (GH PR #4829). PoC supports static-profile and simple proxy-threshold rules. Microbenchmarks show 12-18% latency reduction when routing to INT8 on RISCV cluster (simulated).
2025-03-03: Integration test harness completed. Ran 10k prompt replay; observed two models with >1% degradation on FP8 path — flagged for model-specific conservative thresholds.
2025-03-05: Began wiring telemetry to Console. Spike discovered: switching to INT8 path requires warming KV cache differently; added pre-warm step to tasks.
review_feedback: PM review (Riley Chen): request to include explicit customer impact tags and default safety threshold overrides for enterprise customers.

Applied ML (Dr. Lenora Voss): suggested adding a per-layer fallback mask that forces FP16 for layers with high calibration skew. Recommended a small ensemble of calibration metrics rather than single proxy.
Security review note (S. Patel): confirm calibration artifacts are stored encrypted in S3 and ACL'd; mark ticket for security audit if artifacts are shared externally.
Performance lead (Evan Park): warned about potential cache warmup latency when toggling kernel paths; proposed async warm-start to avoid tail latency spikes.
dependencies: ENG-93310: kv-cache-warmup-extension (pre-warm API for alternate kernels)
